description:
Design an air-core inductor using the Electrical Engineering Calculations app. 

1. Navigate to the 'Inductors' or 'Electronics' category and find the 'Air Core Inductor' (or Coil) calculator.
2. Enter the following physical dimensions:
   - Diameter (d): 40 mm
   - Length (l): 50 mm
   - Turns (N): 35
   (Ensure units are set to millimeters)
3. Calculate the inductance.
4. Save the resulting inductance value (in µH) to a file named '/sdcard/inductor_result.txt'. The file should contain only the numeric value or value with units (e.g., '28.3' or '28.3 uH').
